question:
Simplify the given expression using BODMAS.

(4)/(11) times (121)/(16)times 24 (75² - 55²) times (1)/(100)
solution:
**Concept used:**

BODMAS rule :- Any mathematical expression must be simplified by using the following priority order-Brackets, order of power, division, multiplication, addition and then subtraction. 

**Calculation:**

(4)/(11) times (121)/(16)times 24 (75² - 55²) times (1)/(100) = (11)/(4)times 24(5625-3025)times (1)/(100)=(11times 6×2600)/(100)=​​​​1716

**∴ The value of the given expression is 1716.**
